lyrics.text: I'm the headline, I'm the story
Dripping gold, no need for glory
Floor-to-ceiling, city light
I own the night, I own the night
Penthouse view, the skyline bends
Every message that I send
Makes them wonder, makes them wait
Fashion week or heaven's gate
Watch me glow, watch me rise
Champagne stars in both my eyes
I'm the headline, I'm the story
Dripping gold, no need for glory
Floor-to-ceiling, city light
I own the night, I own the night
They tried to write me out
But I'm the pen, I'm the ink, I'm the shout!
I'M THE HEADLINE, I'M THE STORY!
DRIPPING GOLD, NO NEED FOR GLORY!
FLOOR-TO-CEILING, CITY LIGHT!
I OWN THE NIGHT, I OWN THE NIGHT!
I own the night...
